entities.name: UniProt:P27739
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (460 aa) to reviewed UniProt P27739, annotated as a putative movement protein from Apple chlorotic leaf spot virus isolate plum P863.

UniProt annotation: suppressor of virus-induced RNA silencing; GO annotations include serine-type endopeptidase activity, proteolysis, suppression of host innate immune response, and virus cell-to-cell transport; annotations are not independent assay evidence here.
Sequence-derived properties: estimated mass 50.8 kDa, pI 8.63, GRAVY −0.565; Pfam MP domain PF01107 spans residues 12–201.
